COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.781 of 2023
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. M.C. Pant, Advocate for the 
petitioners.
Mr. Puran Bisht, Additional C.S.C. for 
the State.
Heard. 
Learned counsel for the petitioner 
would submit that the seniority was already 
laid by the respondents, but, some of the 
employees have been given regularisation 
retrospectively and they have been put 
above the petitioners, which is bad in the 
eyes of law. It is also argued that similar 
issue is already pending in WPSS No.692 of 
2023. 
Admit. 
Learned C.S.C. takes notice for the 
respondent nos. 1 to 5. 
Issue notice to the respondent nos. 6 
to 13. 
Respondents may file counter affidavit 
within four weeks. 
Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder 
affidavit, if any, be filed. 
List this matter on 04.07.2023 along 
with WPSS No. 692 of 2023.
Heard on Interim Relief Application IA 
No.1 of 2023. 
Having considered, till the next date of 
listing, the operation of the impugned 
orders dated 19.04.2023 and 26.04.2023, 
shall remain in abeyance.  Interim Relief Application stands 
disposed of, accordingly. 
 (Ravindra Maithani J.) 
05.06.2023
